$comment: Declares every external/local provider AISHA may use. Status vocabulary follows Project 2's convention and is probed live by /api/doctor. A provider is never reported AVAILABLE unless a live probe proved it.

fallback.rule: Used when Ollama is absent. The UI always names the engine that answered.

optionalCloud.rule: Never used implicitly and never required.

ffmpeg.provider: ffmpeg sine synthesis for offline audio artifacts
ffmpeg.note: Deterministic tone track for render pipelines, NOT speech synthesis.

computer.platform: Windows-first; other platforms report UNAVAILABLE with the exact missing binary.

ocr.install: apt install tesseract-ocr / winget install tesseract

deterministic.note: Real raster PNG built from primitives. Never presented as AI generation.

deterministic.provider: ffmpeg from real PNG scenes + captions

email.rule: Sending is HIGH risk, always requires a human approval token, and returns the real SMTP response.

research.rule: Every citation is a retrieved URL with byte evidence; per-engine failures are reported, never hidden.
